title: skenv file
description: The skenv file of a repository: skenv.toml, skenv.yaml, skenv.yml or skenv.json in its root. [repo] is the harness of a skills repository, [environment] the manifest of your machines. Rules the schema cannot check are enforced by skenv: skill names are unique across own and vendor skills, layout.ignore must not match a manifest skill, and a directory holds only one skenv file. Docs: https://qunaxis.github.io/skenv/skenv-file

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors. skenv ignores it.

environment.description: A public repository must not carry [environment]: the manifest is personal (home paths, host names, which skills you use). Keep it in a private repository.
environment.errorMessage: A public repository must not carry [environment]: the manifest is personal. Keep it in a private repository.

repo.description: The [repo] section of the skenv file: the harness of a skills repository, the tooling that `skenv repo apply` generates.

harness.description: The version of the harness templates, which is also the skenv release the generated CI installs. It must not be newer than the templates of the skenv that reads it; `skenv repo apply` moves it to the version of the running skenv.

visibility.description: The visibility of the repository on GitHub: "private" or "public". A public repository must not have [environment], and its CI always runs on ubuntu-latest.

runner.description: The runs-on of the CI jobs, used only when visibility is "private". Default: ["self-hosted", "linux", "docker"]; use ["ubuntu-latest"] for GitHub-hosted runners.

environment.description: The [environment] section of the skenv file: the skills every machine that runs `skenv sync` should have. Paths may start with "~".

layout.description: Where skills are stored and linked.

hosts.description: Declares git servers by alias, usually self-hosted ones: "<alias>:group/repo" in repo is a repository on that server. They live in the manifest so it resolves the same on every machine.

not.errorMessage: This prefix is built in and cannot be declared.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: An alias is lowercase letters, digits and "-", starting with a letter.

own.description: Lists your skills repositories, kept as git working copies: every skill directory in them is linked.

vendor.description: Lists third-party skills, each pinned to a commit and copied into the store. Skill names are unique across own and vendor skills.

host.description: Holds per-machine overrides, keyed by the full or the short hostname.

layout.description: Where skills are stored and linked.

store.description: The directory that holds every skill: links to own skills, copies of vendored ones. Codex reads it directly. Default: "~/.agents/skills".

targets.description: The agent directories that get a link per skill. When set (even to an empty list) it replaces the built-in table: Claude Code ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills, else ~/.claude/skills) and pi (~/.pi/agent/skills), each only if the agent is installed.

ignore.description: Lists glob patterns over entry names (no "/") in the store and the agent directories that belong to other tools: doctor does not report them and sync never touches them, not even with --adopt. A manifest skill must not match a pattern.

items.patternErrorMessage: A glob over entry names, without "/".

own.description: A skills repository of yours, kept as a git working copy so that edits show up immediately.

repo.description: The repository to clone: "owner/repo" on github.com, "gitlab:group/sub/repo", "codeberg:owner/repo", "<alias>:path" of a host in hosts, or a full git URL.

path.description: Where the working copy lives ("~" allowed). Point it at the existing clone, or sync clones a second one there.

skills_dir.description: The directory inside the repository whose subdirectories with a SKILL.md are the skills. Default: "skills".
skills_dir.patternErrorMessage: A relative path inside the repository ("." for its root), without "..", empty segments or a trailing "/".

skills.description: Lists the skills of this repository to install; without it every skill is installed, and a skill added to the repository later is too. A name that is not a skill of the repository is an error. It must not be empty: remove the entry instead.

not.errorMessage: "synced" is reserved: ~/.claude/skills/synced is managed by Claude.

items.patternErrorMessage: A skill name is lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end.

exclude.description: Lists glob patterns over skill names (no "/") that are not installed, applied after skills; host.<name>.skip applies after both. A pattern that matches nothing is fine.

items.patternErrorMessage: A glob over skill names, without "/".

vendor.description: A third-party skill pinned to a commit; `skenv vendor add|update|remove` edit these entries.

name.description: The skill name: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end; "synced" is reserved.

not.errorMessage: "synced" is reserved: ~/.claude/skills/synced is managed by Claude.

name.patternErrorMessage: A skill name is lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end.

repo.description: The repository: "owner/repo" on github.com, "gitlab:group/sub/repo", "codeberg:owner/repo", "<alias>:path" of a host in hosts, or a full git URL.

path.description: The directory with SKILL.md inside the repository, relative to its root; "." for the root. Default: ".".
path.patternErrorMessage: A relative path inside the repository ("." for its root), without "..", empty segments or a trailing "/".

rev.description: The full 40-character lowercase commit SHA. Branches, tags and short SHAs are rejected: a vendored skill changes only when you update it.
rev.patternErrorMessage: A full 40-character lowercase commit SHA; branches, tags and short SHAs are not allowed.

host.description: Holds the overrides of one machine.

skip.description: Lists skills that are neither stored nor linked on this host.

gitHost.description: A git server declared in the manifest, usually a self-hosted one: "<alias>:group/repo" is a repository on it. It lives in the manifest rather than in the tool config, so the manifest resolves the same on every machine.

url.description: The https base of the server, such as "https://git.example.com": "<alias>:group/repo" is cloned from <url>/group/repo.git. It must not carry credentials; use a git credential helper.
url.patternErrorMessage: A base URL such as "https://git.example.com", without credentials.

type.description: The software of the server: "github", "gitlab" (subgroups of any depth), "gitea" (Gitea, Forgejo) or "generic" (any path, cloned as written, ".git" is not added). It sets the accepted paths and is recorded for CI templates and imports. Default: "generic".

ssh.description: The ssh address of the server, such as "git@git.example.com" or "ssh://git@git.example.com:2222"; add the path prefix of repositories over ssh when it differs from the one in url. skenv clones over https; this address is recognised in remotes and named in the url.insteadOf hint when access fails. Default: git@<host of url>.
